results.corrected_title: Asian stocks plunge as AI shares tumble; Kospi down 6.2%, SoftBank down 14.8%
results.corrected_summary: On 25 November 2026 Asian markets fell sharply as AI-related shares slid. The Kospi dropped 6.2%, Samsung Electronics 9.9%, SK Hynix 11.1%, SoftBank Group 14.8% and Japan's Nikkei 225 2.8%. AP attributes the drop to investor worry that AI stock valuations are unjustifiably high and that AI may not earn enough to justify heavy spending. High inflation (October PCE 3.8%) and the chance of a Fed rate hike in December added pressure.
key_facts: AP ties the selloff to concern that AI valuations are too high
October PCE inflation 3.8% raises odds of a December Fed hike

results.corrected_title: OpenAI: GPT-6 models show intrinsic protein design ability, self-reported lab results
results.corrected_summary: OpenAI's 24 November 2026 post says GPT-6-family models can design protein shapes and sequences using only reasoning and code. On PoseBusters docking, an internal model matched the observed pose in 96% of cases and GPT-6.2 in 93%, against 50% for DiffDock-L. In lab tests with Onava, 35 of 322 minibinders (10.9%) bound their targets, but specialized models supplied sequences and filtered candidates. The results are self-reported.
key_facts: 96% PoseBusters accuracy belongs to the internal model; GPT-6.2 scored 93%; DiffDock-L scored 50%
Specialized models (ProteinMPNN, SolubleMPNN, Boltz-2 and others) were used for sequences and filtering
Not end-to-end de novo design; structure prediction is weak
Self-reported by OpenAI; flags biosecurity risks

results.corrected_title: Google Workspace MCP servers and CLI now available, with new API usage tiers
results.corrected_summary: On 24 November 2026 Google announced Google-hosted Workspace MCP servers and a Workspace CLI for AI agents, covering Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Chat and Tasks. Usage tiers now apply, starting with Gmail, Drive and Calendar. The Standard tier is free; the Scaled tier is paid. From 1 February 2027 agents must use MCP or the CLI instead of calling REST APIs directly, and Scaled billing starts on 1 April 2027.
key_facts: MCP servers cover Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Chat and Tasks
Standard tier is free; Google says over 99% of active developers are on it
1 Feb 2027: agents must use MCP or the CLI, not REST APIs directly
Admins get agent controls, audit logs and DLP
results.issues: Do not say 'generally available'; rollout takes about 2 weeks.

results.corrected_title: Gemini 4 Neon (launched 18 Nov) reportedly reaching Workspace customers via the Gemini app
results.corrected_summary: Gemini 4 Neon was first announced on 18 November 2026, before the window, so the launch is stale. Only ThursdAI lists a 24 November Workspace rollout. No primary Google source confirms it.
key_facts: Gemini 4 Neon announced around 18 Nov 2026, outside the window
Only ThursdAI reports a 24 Nov Workspace rollout (single source)
results.issues: Stale launch (18 Nov); Workspace rollout uncorroborated. Drop.
